narrative.overview:
Vault is finished like a premium black metal card: brushed graphite, a fine platinum edge, and nothing on it that does not need to be there. It is a private ledger for two people, so the tone is calm, exact and quietly confident. The interface is dark first, built from standard iPhone parts (large titles, a labelled tab bar, grouped lists, segmented controls, switches, swipe actions), and lets the material and the numbers carry the character instead of decoration.

Colour is rationed. The app itself is black, white and platinum; the only saturated colours belong to the two people who use it, sky for Bilal and rose for Hiba, so who contributed what is readable at a glance. Moments of progress (a milestone passed, a goal reached) are marked quietly in place and celebrated in full only once.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first, near-black ground with graphite cards and hairline edges.
One neutral accent (platinum) for actions and progress; graphite in light mode.
Two person colours, used only for people and their data.
Money set in Sora with tabular figures; everything else in SF Pro.
Native iOS structure; brand lives in the material and the restraint.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Only Bilal and Hiba get colour. Goals, states and charts that are not about a person are platinum or neutral.

rules.name: The Platinum Is a Promise Rule
rules.body: Platinum means "you can act on this" or "this is progress". It never decorates.

rules.name: The No Gold, No Glow Rule
rules.body: No warm metallic accent, no coloured halos, no ambient colour blobs. A single faint neutral haze at the top of a screen is the maximum.

rules.name: The Money Has Its Own Voice Rule
rules.body: Every dollar figure uses Sora with tabular figures; nothing else does.

rules.name: The 11pt Floor Rule
rules.body: No text below 11pt, and 11pt is reserved for tab labels.

rules.name: The One Object Rule
rules.body: Only the hero card gets material and a drop shadow. Every other surface is flat graphite.

dos: Do keep the accent platinum (#D9DDE3) in dark mode and graphite (#4A5260) in light mode.
Do use the standard iOS tab bar, grouped lists, segmented controls, switches and swipe actions.
Do set every amount in Sora with tabular figures, and drop ".00" on whole-dollar totals.
Do show sync status ("Synced with Hiba · just now") wherever totals appear, and design the empty, can't-sync and loading states.
Do mark a crossed milestone quietly in place, and save the full celebration for the first time it happens.
donts: Don't use gold or any warm metallic accent.
Don't add ambient colour glows, glow filters, glass/frosted cards or gradient text.
Don't bring back the vault-dial pattern inside the hero card; the dial lives only in the logo, widgets and notification icon.
Don't give goals their own colours; goals are told apart by icon.
Don't show two add buttons at the same time, or put a custom floating tab bar in place of the system one.
